purpose: Static C2 instruction evidence only; not a performance profile.
caveats: Static instruction counts are not dynamic execution frequencies or timing results.
Select the latest normal compilation per method; OSR and superseded compilations are separate code versions, not additive work.
updateBatch has no standalone C2 compilation in these captures; its vector update callees are present. This is consistent with inlining but not an inlining trace.
Scalar output dot products, range reduction, exponent scaling and some control/tail paths remain scalar by design.

Stack stores can preserve deoptimization state; only explicit unconditional paths ending in annotated UncommonTrapBlob are classified as deoptimization exits. Remaining stores are not automatically hot-loop spills.
verification_scope: Expected-width packed FMA in all captured compute methods and packed FAST polynomial arithmetic. This does not certify all mask operations intrinsic, zero allocation, hot-path spill frequency, or performance.

gaps.finding: Latest FP64-128 cohort update/updateOnline each have four inline TLAB top stores, seven static helper calls, two new-array and two new-instance allocator slow paths, and no native masked-store instructions. Packed FMA arithmetic is present; the masked update path still uses helpers/allocations.
gaps.cause_status: The masked vector operations are the likely source; exact callee names are not retained by the filtered capture, so that attribution remains an inference.
gaps.impact: The captured default FP64-256 updates have no TLAB top stores, static helper calls, or allocator slow paths and use native vmaskmovpd stores. FP32-128/256 similarly use native vmaskmovps without these allocation paths.
